subject: indiv-td
title: (R)INDIV.TD.------AFL.
description: Chart on book p. 95 ((AF)D-23). INDIV-TD (individual tendencies) is the subject, with the (R) prefix, "the reality of"; AFL (affinity alignment) is the partner. From the subject: PROJ-CONT (projectional continuance). From PROJ-CONT: INFO-AF-B (information affinity basis). From INFO-AF-B: POST (postulation), with the (C) prefix, "the concept of", and RT-DY (reality dynamics). From POST: PROJ-DY (projectional dynamics). From RT-DY: VT-ATT (vibrational attitude). From VT-ATT: T-C-IMP (time continuum implications) and RT-OP (reality options).
